rules.threshold_text: 50 MW: Peak Contract Demand forecast at or above a Monthly Maximum Demand of 50,000 kW of firm load at a single location, including co-located load; sites on the system as of 31 December 2025 not subject to the added requirements
rules.contract_term: Minimum Term 20 years from permanent service, which may include a Load Ramp Period; termination after service begins needs written notice no later than two years before the termination date
rules.collateral: Security Amount equal to a Security Percentage of the applicable termination payment, set by credit review, revised annually; at least 10% where the termination obligation exceeds 100 million USD; in a standby irrevocable letter of credit or cash, a parent guarantee reducing the percentage. CIAC: 100% of the estimated cost to extend service paid in advance, refunded over up to five years as base revenues are collected
rules.exit_fee: Termination before full load ramp: the Company's actual costs incurred (Termination Payment Obligation). Termination before the end of the term: a Termination Fee of three years of Minimum Monthly Bills plus the net book value of new facilities, less any unrefunded refundable CIAC
rules.study_timeline: Study duration not published. A non-refundable system impact study fee of 150,000 USD (150,000 USD more for updates); the customer must enter an LLCA or a reimbursement agreement within three months of receiving the system impact study
